svg.title: Pranay Kadu — meet Pawny
svg.desc: A glossy white-faced robot in vivid red and violet armor smiles and slowly waves. The large greeting changes one language at a time, in order: English, Mandarin Chinese, Malay, Hindi, Spanish, and French. Each lasts six seconds. Animation stops on English when reduced motion is preferred. Transparent artwork optimized for a GitHub profile README.

g.text: Java · Spring Boot · Distributed Systems · AWS
